《Mechanical Design Handbook》 6th Edition consists of 5 volumes, covering all contents of mechanical routine design. Volume 1 includes general design data, mechanical drawing, limits and fits, shape and position tolerances and surface structures, common mechanical engineering materials, mechanisms, and mechanical product structural design; Volume 2 includes connections and fastenings, shafts and their connections, bearings, hoisting and conveying machinery components, operating parts, small hardware, and pipe fittings; Volume 3 includes lubrication and sealing, springs, spiral transmission, friction wheel transmission, belt and chain transmission, and gear transmission; Volume 4 includes multi-point engagement flexible transmission, reducers and speed changers, common motors and electrical appliances, and electric (hydraulic) push rods and hoists, control and utilization of mechanical vibrations, and frame design; Volume 5 includes hydraulic transmission, hydraulic control, pneumatic transmission, etc.

《Mechanical Design Handbook》 6th Edition is compiled based on the successful experience of the previous five editions, considering the usage habits of readers and new requirements for the 《Mechanical Design Handbook》. The 《Mechanical Design Handbook》 maintains the style, features, and quality of the previous five editions: emphasizing practicality, considering from the perspective of mechanical design personnel, reasonably arranging content selection and compilation system; emphasizing accuracy, data and information mainly from standards, specifications, and other authoritative sources, design methods, formulas, and parameter selection have been tested through long-term practice, and design examples come from engineering practice; reflecting advancement, many new materials, new methods, new technologies, and new processes suitable for China's national conditions with broad application prospects have been added, new standards and specifications have been adopted, and many new products with advanced levels and standardization have been widely collected; highlighting the characteristics of practicality and easy reference. The 《Mechanical Design Handbook》 can be used as a reference book for mechanical design personnel and related engineering technical personnel, and can also be used as a reference for teachers and students of related majors in colleges and universities.

The Mechanical Design Handbook, since its first edition was published in 1969, has been revised five times, with a cumulative sales volume of 1.3 million sets, becoming the most influential and bestselling mechanical design reference book in New China. As a key national science and technology book, the Mechanical Design Handbook has won multiple national and provincial/ministerial awards. Among them, it won the Science and Technology Achievement Award of the National Science Conference in 1978, the Excellent Science and Technology Book Award of the Ministry of Chemical Industry in 1983, the Second Prize of the National Excellent Science and Technology Book Award in 1995, the Second Prize of the National Chemical Industry Science and Technology Progress Award in 1999, the First Prize of the Excellent Science and Technology Book Award of the Petroleum and Chemical Industry in 2002, and the Second Prize of the Science and Technology Progress Award of China Petroleum and Chemical Industry in 2003. From 1986 to 2015, it was repeatedly rated as an excellent bestseller nationwide.

Keeping pace with the times and pioneering innovation, achieving the best combination of practicality, reliability and innovation, assisting mechanical designers in developing better and newer products, adapting to market and production needs, and improving market competitiveness and international competitiveness, this is the consistent and unremitting highest purpose of the Mechanical Design Handbook.

It has been 8 years since the fifth edition of the Mechanical Design Handbook (hereinafter referred to as the Handbook) was published and distributed. During this period, we conducted extensive research, invited experts and scholars in the field of machinery to discuss many times, listened to their suggestions for the revision of the sixth edition, and went deep into design institutes, factories and mines to understand the application of the Handbook and opinions of the vast number of design workers, timely discovered and collected new experiences and new problems in production practice, tracked and collected new technologies and new products emerging at home and abroad in a multi-dimensional and multi-channel manner, improved and enriched the content of the Handbook, made the Handbook more vibrant, and maximized the ability of the vast number of mechanical designers to innovate independently to meet the needs of building an innovative country.

The specific revision of the Handbook Sixth Edition is as follows:

I. In terms of improving product development and innovative design

1. A new Chapter 5 "Mechanical Product Structural Design" is added, proposing 12 common principles for the structural design of common mechanical products for product designers to refer to.

2. Chapter 1 "General Design Data" adds contents such as clever (innovative) examples and wrong examples of mechanical product design.

3. Chapter 11 "Lubrication and Sealing" adds design calculation contents of rare lubrication devices to meet the needs of new product development and design of lubrication.

4. Chapter 15 "Gear Transmission" further improves the design of involute cylindrical gears conforming to the latest ISO international standards, non-zero modified bevel gears design, point-line meshing transmission design, multi-point meshing flexible transmission design and other contents. For example, geometric calculation and examples of involute gears conforming to ISO standards are added, and gear accuracy is updated.

5. Chapter 23 "Pneumatic Transmission" adds contents such as modular electric/pneumatic hybrid drive technology and energy saving of pneumatic systems.

2. In providing new components and new materials for the development of new products and the innovation of old products
1. Relevant energy-saving technologies and products are introduced, such as energy-saving technologies and products for pneumatic systems, energy-saving motors, etc.
2. Each chapter introduces many new mechanical parts, including new types of couplings, clutches, brakes, motors with reducers, lifting and transportation parts, hydraulic components and accessories, pneumatic components, etc. These products all have the characteristics of advanced technology, energy saving, etc.
3. In terms of new materials, content on copper and copper alloys, aluminum and aluminum alloys, titanium and titanium alloys, magnesium and magnesium alloys, etc. has been added or improved. These alloy materials are widely used in aerospace, aviation, high-speed rail, computers, communication components, electronic products, textiles, printing and other industries due to their excellent mechanical properties, physical properties, and high material recycling rates.
III. In implementing and promoting standardization
1. All products, materials, and processes adopt new standard data, such as materials, various mechanical parts, hydraulic and pneumatic components, etc., all of which have been updated with technical standards and products.
2. To meet the needs of generalization and internationalization of mechanical products, content is compiled in accordance with the principle of focusing on national standards and facing international standards, such as Chapter 15 "Gear Transmission" which updates and improves the design of involute gears conforming to ISO standards.
On the occasion of the publication of the sixth edition of the "Mechanical Design Handbook," we would like to express our heartfelt thanks again to the units and individuals who participated in the compilation of each edition! We also thank the units and friends from all walks of life who have provided us with strong support and enthusiastic help!
Due to the limited level of the authors and the incomplete survey work, there may be omissions and shortcomings in the revision. We sincerely ask readers to continue to give us criticism and corrections.
